input: I want to increase the navigablility of the ghp site by a lot.
errors: Topic-page chips first used a ../ prefix one level too shallow; check.mjs caught 650 dead links before push and it was fixed.

validate went red from main, not this diff: #8497 added rel=manifest/apple-touch-icon to bid-price-engine, the front-door mirror dropped it and cascaded 1,297 -> 105 tools. Fixed in this PR by stripping both rels in the mirror (front-door-tools.mjs) and regenerating.

doc_friction.issue: 2,000+ lines; nothing says research project pages are the least-linked part of the site. A link-graph audit of dist/ found it in a minute (680 of 695 low-inbound pages).
simdesign-pocketmesh and simdesign-gaugepockets carry identical titles (near-duplicate studies); surfaced as a duplicate <title> once titles stopped being slugs.

discoverEligible's fixpoint turns one dead link in a hub tool into a mass drop with 62 unrelated-looking test failures; the dropped map (explainIneligible) is the fastest route to the root cause but nothing in the failure output points at it.

deviations.why: Named task from the user, routed with --track ventures (site work) rather than the redteam draw.

notes: Navigability of the Pages site: audited the built site's link graph, found research project pages were dead ends. Added 26 research topic pages, breadcrumbs, prev/next and 'more in topic' on 701 project pages, on-site links from the research index. Pages with <=1 inbound link 695 -> 15. Also fixed red-on-main validate (front-door mirror) caused by #8497.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: audit link graph, design topic level, builder + templates + tests, verify in browser

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
CI minutes and the reviewer bots' own model calls
